headword: {優先順位|ゆうせんじゅんい}

definitions.explanation: The order in which things should be done based on their importance or urgency.

examples.japanese: {優先順位|ゆうせんじゅんい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦つける→つける：00562_tsukeru⟧。
{優先順位|ゆうせんじゅんい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{高|たか}い→高い：00500_takai⟧もの⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{対応|たいおう}→対応：02510_taiou⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: We will address items starting with the highest priority.

examples.japanese: ⟦{仕事|しごと}→仕事：00480_shigoto⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{優先順位|ゆうせんじゅんい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{見直|みなお}す→見直す：04579_minaosu⟧⟦{必要|ひつよう}→必要：00846_hitsuyou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: We need to reassess our work priorities.

notes:
A compound of ⟦{優先|ゆうせん}→優先：15243_yuusen⟧ (priority) + ⟦{順位|じゅんい}→順位：14679_juni⟧ (ranking/order). Refers to the order in which tasks or issues should be addressed based on importance or urgency.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {優先順位|ゆうせんじゅんい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦つける→つける：00562_tsukeru⟧: to set priorities
- {優先順位|ゆうせんじゅんい}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{高|たか}い→高い：00500_takai⟧/⟦{低|ひく}い→低い：02947_hikui⟧: high/low priority
- {優先順位|ゆうせんじゅんい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{決|き}める→決める：00858_kimeru⟧: to determine priorities
- {優先順位|ゆうせんじゅんい}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{従|したが}って→従う：02059_shitagau⟧: according to priority
- {優先順位|ゆうせんじゅんい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{見直|みなお}す→見直す：04579_minaosu⟧: to reassess priorities

USAGE:
Very common in business and project management contexts. Often appears in meetings when discussing task allocation or workflow.

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{優先|ゆうせん}→優先：15243_yuusen⟧: priority (simpler form)
- ⟦{優先|ゆうせん}→優先：15243_yuusen⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to prioritize
- {重要度|じゅうようど}: degree of importance
- {緊急度|きんきゅうど}: degree of urgency
